flows:
Navigate to https://www.sfmta.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Assert that the visible Play/Pause control for the homepage carousel is keyboard focusable.
Activate it with Tab and Enter to pause the carousel.
Verify the control reports aria-pressed false.

summary:
The requested action was to use Tab and Enter to activate the visible Play/Pause control for the homepage carousel and pause it.
The run remained on the SFMTA homepage, but the carousel Play/Pause control could not be confirmed as reachable with the keyboard.
Because that control was not keyboard focusable, it could not be activated with Tab and Enter, so the carousel was not paused and its pressed state could not be checked.
